title: Solo Desktop App
description: I've been really enjoying using the Solo desktop app for smaller projects, having everything running and restarting automatically is like magic, and using agents on the current branch is much more preferable to me than worktree-based solutions.

title: The Steam Machine Arrives
description: I've been waiting for this for a while, and typically, I can't pick one up for a while. But at least i'll be able to see how the reviews pan out, and if it'll play the games I want it to play - but i'd guess that it won't be able to run star citizen, eh?
